deadline.value: Apply by 11:59pm PST, Wednesday December 2, 2026 for Autumn 2027; no rolling admission.
deadline.quote: The deadline for all PhD applications to be submitted online for the Department of Statistics for matriculation in Autumn Quarter 2027 is Wednesday, December 2, 2026.

gre_subject.value: The GRE Mathematics Subject Test is optional but recommended.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Math Subject Test is optional, but recommended.

gre_general.value: The GRE General Test is required (a waiver is possible only if you already hold a PhD).
gre_general.quote: Applicants to our program are still required to take the GRE General Test. | Applicants who already hold a PhD degree from an accredited institution may request a waiver for the general test

supervisor.value: The admissions page does not mention contacting a supervisor before applying.

funding.value: All admitted PhD students are guaranteed five years of 12-month funding (tuition, health insurance and salary/stipend).
funding.quote: All students accepted to the Ph.D. program are guaranteed five years of 12-month funding through spring quarter of the fifth year, which includes tuition, Stanford's Cardinal Care health insurance, and a salary or stipend.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree (or international equivalent) is the minimum requirement.
entry_route.quote: You must hold, or expect to hold before enrollment at Stanford, a U.S. bachelor’s degree or its international equivalent from a college or university of recognized standing.

notes: Fee is $125 for domestic and international applicants alike. GRE General required, unlike most Stanford STEM programs.
